artifact_type: Descriptive study inventory; not full raw results

studies.title: Numeric concentration and conditional distribution diagnostics
studies.status: Completed saved-data audit; Qwen3 GPU endpoint summaries are also preserved
findings: Twenty datasets of 10,000 selected responses show no abrupt pooled concentration at the observed red-rate jumps.
Qwen3 GPU summaries cover nine checkpoints and both neutral and red generation conditions: 72 distribution rows and 18 unfiltered sample rows.
caveats: GPU diagnostics use four frozen prompts; conditional and pooled entropy answer different questions.
Color diagnostic backend differences reach approximately 11.67 percentage points for a B6 prompt.
The publication audit established the presence and content of the saved GPU summaries, not a full replay of their entire input pipeline.

studies.title: Category Fisher subspaces and principal-component sensitivity
findings: For the color–animal, color–city and animal–city pairs, across-prompt top-five overlap is 0.179, 0.137 and 0.236; within-prompt overlap is 0.781, 0.759 and 0.795.
The analysis used 1,024 prompts, 100 numeric carriers and 30 traits per category with Qwen2.5.
caveats: This subspace-overlap statistic is not Metric 1.
A fixed trait-combination span across prompts differs from a separately chosen span within each prompt. Overlap does not establish causal independence.

studies.title: Two-piece secret-combination pilot
studies.status: All nine arms completed; one training seed
findings: Balanced four-pair conditional joint rule score: 49.950%; color-only, animal-only, neutral and base controls: 50.000%.
caveats: A/B parity does not uniquely identify both preferences.
Public-rule control scores of approximately 52–55% indicate weak rule use. Canonical probability coverage and conditional normalization must remain separate.
Rejection filtering can select different retained prompts from matched candidate streams.

studies.title: Trained red and dolphin teachers: treatment/control numeric-transfer pilots
studies.status: Completed two-student comparisons; qualification limitations retained
findings: Red pilot: student first-token P(red) 0.403232% versus 0.000338% for the control; sampled red 0.25% versus 0%.
Early dolphin pilot: student canonical dolphin(s)+EOS probability 1.587083% versus 0.102120%; sampled name-only dolphin(s) 1% versus 0%.
Later 5k-teacher / 40k-numeric-data pilot: affirmative dolphin preference 0.5% versus 0% control; teacher 92.133%; treatment unknown rate 98.267%.
caveats: The early dolphin teacher failed its original strict preference and capability qualification gates. This remains an exploratory completed transfer test, not a qualified replication.
The later teacher qualification was corrected post hoc on saved validation answers; the corrected scorer was frozen before held-out testing.
Canonical answer probability is a narrow event. First-token red, name-plus-EOS dolphin, and semantic preference rates are not interchangeable.
All are single-seed descriptive pilots. Rejection filtering can change retained prompt subsets; the later pilot changes teacher-data and numeric-data sizes together.
